title: Mid-Semester Exam Schedule
summary: Mid-semester examinations commence on September 1st, 2026. Hall tickets will be issued via the portal on August 25th.
details: All students must maintain 75% attendance to be eligible for hall tickets. Seating arrangements will be displayed on StudentHub 2 days prior to each exam.

title: Campus Placement Registration
summary: Final year students must complete their T&P portal registration before August 30th for upcoming recruitment drives.
details: Prepare your resumes in standard PDF format. Mock interview sessions will be held in Auditorium 2 starting August 22nd.

title: Annual Sports Festival 2026
summary: Registrations are now open for inter-departmental sports events. Contact student coordinators for team submissions.
details: Matches will take place at the main university sports complex. Refreshments and certificates are provided to all participants.

title: Hall Ticket Download Window
summary: Hall tickets for the mid-semester exams are now available for download from the student dashboard.
details: Carry a printed copy of your hall ticket and college ID card to every exam. Students with attendance shortage should contact their HOD immediately.

title: Ganesh Chaturthi Holiday
summary: The college will remain closed on September 14th on account of Ganesh Chaturthi.
details: Lectures scheduled for the day will be rescheduled. Updated timetables will be shared by respective departments.

title: Assignment Submission Deadline Extended
summary: The deadline for pending Unit 2 assignments has been extended to August 31st.
details: Late submissions after the extended deadline will not be accepted. Upload your work through the Assignments page in PDF, ZIP or DOCX format.

title: TCS Recruitment Drive
summary: TCS will conduct an on-campus recruitment drive for 2027 graduating students on September 18th.
details: Eligibility: 60% throughout with no active backlogs. Online aptitude test followed by technical and HR interviews.

title: Library Timing Change
summary: The central library will stay open until 9 PM on weekdays during the exam season.
details: The extended timings apply from August 20th to September 15th. Reading hall seats are first-come, first-served.

title: Semester Fee Payment Reminder
summary: The last date for paying the odd-semester fee without a late fine is September 20th.
details: Fees can be paid online through the university payment gateway. Keep the transaction receipt for future reference.

title: Hackathon: Code for Campus
summary: A 24-hour hackathon for teams of up to four students. Exciting prizes and internship offers for winners.
details: Register your team on the Coding Club portal before September 15th. Problem statements will be released at the opening ceremony.

title: Navratri Vacation
summary: Navratri vacation will be observed from October 11th to October 20th.
details: Hostels will remain open for students who wish to stay. The academic calendar has been adjusted accordingly.

title: Re-Exam Form Submission
summary: Students who missed a mid-semester exam can apply for a re-exam until September 24th.
details: Applications must include a valid medical certificate or official leave approval. Forms are available in the Exam Cell.

title: Infosys Pre-Placement Talk
summary: Infosys will hold a pre-placement talk in the Seminar Hall on September 12th at 11 AM.
details: Attendance is mandatory for all students who wish to apply for the Infosys recruitment drive.

title: Guest Lecture on Cloud Computing
summary: An industry expert from AWS will deliver a guest lecture on modern cloud architecture.
details: The session will be held in Auditorium 1 on September 6th. Certificates of participation will be issued.
